elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate
elements.evidence: "commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate"
"professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000"

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M where vendor processes Customer Data
elements.evidence: "cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering TrueLink's hosting of the Web Site and processing of Client Content and other Client data"

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: "workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law"
"shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request"

elements.element: Vendor obligation to maintain coverage during the term
elements.evidence: "shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement"
"errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000" (exceeds USD 1M)
"cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000" (exceeds USD 2M)

reasons: Preferred level is fully satisfied: CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to hosting and processing of Client data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request.
Fallback thresholds are also exceeded, but the locked target is preferred and it is met on its own terms.

The insertion is otherwise an appropriately concise stand-alone clause for an absent obligation, and the untouched force majeure paragraph remains effective with no undefined terms introduced (Web Site, Client Content, Client, TrueLink all already defined).

Minimality is short by one element: the one-year post-termination coverage tail ("and for one (1) year thereafter") is a duty the playbook position does not require; deleting those words would leave the preferred level fully met.
